video: The Kids Who Hacked the World, Part 2: The Teens Who Stole the Next Xbox

reels.title: Arrested at the Border Over a Gamer Tag
reels.hook: He drove to the border to pick up a car bumper. He left in handcuffs.

reels.title: Secret Xbox Dev Kits Found in a Scrapyard
reels.hook: Secret Xbox dev kits turned up at a recycling yard. That's how it all started.

reels.title: The Teen Who Sold Call of Duty Cheats
reels.hook: A teenager said he made 8,000 dollars a day selling Call of Duty cheats.

reels.title: The Teen Gang That Hacked Microsoft
reels.hook: A 14-year-old and his online friends built a gang that hacked Microsoft.

reels.title: How One Password Opened Epic Games
reels.hook: One reused password let a teenager walk straight into Epic Games.

reels.title: Gears of War 3 Leaked in a 'Wedding Videos' Box
reels.hook: They mailed a stolen Gears of War 3 in a box marked wedding videos.

reels.title: The Teen Who Spied Through Office Webcams
reels.hook: He watched game studio staff through their own office webcams.

reels.title: Teen Hackers Got Inside 25 Giant Companies
reels.hook: Microsoft, Valve, Disney, Google. Teenagers got inside about 25 companies.

reels.title: Gamers Who Downloaded an Army Helicopter Sim
reels.hook: Teenage gamers downloaded a US Army helicopter simulator.

reels.title: They Built the Xbox One Before It Was Revealed
reels.hook: Kids built the Xbox One before Microsoft even revealed it.

reels.title: A Secret Xbox Prototype on eBay
reels.hook: He put a secret Xbox prototype on eBay. Bids passed 20,000 dollars.

reels.title: He Stole From Microsoft, Then Got Hired
reels.hook: A fan stole three Xbox prototypes. Then Microsoft offered him a job.

reels.title: How the Xbox Underground Got Caught
reels.hook: One by one, police came for every gamer in the gang.

reels.title: Who Was 'Person A'?
reels.hook: The FBI had years of their chats. The source was called Person A.

reels.title: What Happened to the Xbox Hackers
reels.hook: Two of them got 18 months in prison for hacking Xbox.
